Set up Supabase OAuth sign-in

Source: R/backend__supabase.R
oauth_db_supabase_client.Rd

Create a sign-in client for a Supabase project with its OAuth 2.1 server enabled. Pass it to shinyOAuth's UI and server modules, then query with oauth_db_supabase_api().

Usage

oauth_db_supabase_client(
  url,
  client_id,
  redirect_uri,
  client_secret = NULL,
  ...,
  provider = .odb_supabase_provider(url, client_secret),
  scopes = c("openid", "profile", "email")
)

Arguments

url

Supabase project base URL. Ignored when provider is supplied.

client_id

Application ID from the OAuth registration.

redirect_uri

Registered URL where the browser returns after sign-in.

client_secret

Client secret, or NULL for a public client.

...

Other arguments for shinyOAuth::oauth_client().

provider

A custom shinyOAuth provider, replacing Supabase discovery.

scopes

Identity scopes to request. The defaults request openid, profile, and email; these do not grant database permissions.

Value

A shinyOAuth OAuthClient. Create it outside server().

Details

Enable Supabase's OAuth server, configure its sign-in and consent UI, and register the app's exact redirect URI. Use asymmetric JWT signing keys for OIDC. The default provider makes an HTTPS OIDC discovery request to the project's /auth/v1 issuer and enables PKCE and nonce validation.

A nonempty secret selects HTTP Basic client authentication; without one, the preset uses a public client. Supabase returns refresh tokens without an offline_access scope. shinyOAuth handles renewal.

For a third-party provider configured in Supabase, pass its provider here or use an ordinary shinyOAuth::oauth_client().

See also

oauth_db_supabase_api(). vignette("supabase", package = "shinyOAuthDB").

Other sign-in configuration: oauth_db_bigquery_client(), oauth_db_databricks_client(), oauth_db_databricks_provider(), oauth_db_microsoft_client(), oauth_db_snowflake_client(), oauth_db_snowflake_provider()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
client <- oauth_db_supabase_client(
  url = Sys.getenv("OAUTHDB_SUPABASE_URL"),
  client_id = Sys.getenv("OAUTHDB_CLIENT_ID"),
  client_secret = Sys.getenv("OAUTHDB_CLIENT_SECRET"),
  redirect_uri = "http://localhost:8100"
)
} # }
